After 2 days, A and B complete:
\[
2\left(\frac14+\frac1{14}\right)=\frac{9}{14}
\]
Remaining work:
\[
1-\frac{9}{14}=\frac{5}{14}
\]

Now A, B, and C work together. Their combined rate:
\[
\frac14+\frac1{14}+\frac17=\frac{13}{28}
\]

Time needed to finish the remaining \(\frac{5}{14}=\frac{10}{28}\) work:
\[
\frac{10/28}{13/28}=\frac{10}{13}\text{ days}
\]
Since \(\frac{10}{13}<1\), the work finishes before A leaves.

Total time:
\[
2+\frac{10}{13}=\frac{36}{13}
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{36}{13}\text{ days}}
\]
